neighbours.label: organized care and activity programs for children outside school: summer camp, afterschool, youth clubs, daycare (not army or refugee camps)
fire: Every July our son counts the days until sleepaway camp begins.
Parents can register online for the afterschool club at the library.
The day camp offers crafts, canoeing and archery for ages six to twelve.
Volunteers at the youth club helped the children with homework.
Her first job was as a counselor at a summer camp in Maine.
The Boys and Girls Club of Denver opens a new centre next month.
Many working parents rely on daycare and after-school care for their kids.
The campers sang songs around the fire before lights out.
quiet: Every July our son counts the days until the football season begins.
Parents can register online for the book sale at the library.
The military base offers housing and training for new recruits.
Volunteers at the refugee camp handed out blankets and water.
Her first job was as a waitress at a seafood restaurant in Maine.
The Rotary Club of Denver opens a new office next month.
Many working adults rely on buses and trains for their commute.
The soldiers sang songs around the fire before lights out.

notes: Started as ' camp' on the card; the probe showed the meaning matters. Refugee and army camps read 0.01 and 'afterschool', 'Clubs', 'daycare', 'counselors' read 0.35-1.15, so the shared pattern is who the program is for rather than the word camp.
